t: Pamphlete Advocating Patronage Of The Newly Opened Wang Ching Wei Central Reserve Bank Of China

1.
6.30a.m. to 7.00a.m.

Detective Office.
Pamphlets Advocating Patronage of the
newly opened Wang Ching Wei Central
Reserve Bank of China.
At 6.30 a.m. 20-1-41 P.S. 20 Sherwood brought to
the station four pamphlets advocating support of the
newly opened Central Reserve Bank which he found on the
roadway and posted on walls along Avenue Foch between
Tamsui Road and Chungking Road.
Translations as follows:-
(1) "The new legal tender can purchase foreign
exchange and exchange the old bank notes
without limit."
(2) "Support the new legal tender which has
unlimited reserves and credit."
Issued by the United celebration
association of the Shanghai City
Government."
The 4 pamphlets are forwarded herewith to the
Special Branch for disposal.
R. Shemmis.
D.S. 193,
C.D.B. 26,
Sen. Det. 1/c.
D. D. O. "A"
Special Branch Officer i/c.

1941年1月20日，
1.
6.30a.m. 至 7.00a.m.
1941年1月20日。
侦探股。
宣传拥护新开业的汪精卫中央储备银行的传单。
1941年1月20日上午6时30分，第20巡捕房的舍伍德（Sherwood）将在福煦路（Avenue Foch）淡水路与重庆路之间路段的路面及墙壁上发现的四张宣传支持新开业的中央储备银行的传单带至警局。
译文如下：
(1) “新法币可无限制购买外汇并兑换旧钞票。”
(2) “支持拥有无限准备金和信用的新法币。”
由上海市政府联合庆祝协会发布。”
现将这4张传单随文移送特务科处置。
R. Shemmis.
侦探警佐 193号，
刑事侦缉处 B组 26号，
高级侦探 1等。
“A”区侦探股主管。
特务科主管警官。
